Usage of `prufyx check` and `prufyx prepare` for this project, as

coverage: `prufyx catalog cncf --project buildpacks`. Shared flags, exit status and

## check cncf

```text
prufyx check cncf --project buildpacks --current-lifecycle-config FILE --proposed-lifecycle-config FILE --from 0.16.5 --to 0.17.7 --current-platform-api 0.11 --proposed-platform-api 0.12|0.13 (--now RFC3339 | --knowledge-db DIR) [--current-lifecycle-config-digest SHA256] [--proposed-lifecycle-config-digest SHA256] [--replay-report FILE] [--format human|json]
```
